text: Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, parsed; title and argument are context only to identify the OP's view) makes a specific counter-argument to the OP's view AND, within that same comment, cites an empirical example: a concrete real-world case, documented instance, statistic/study finding, or specific personal experience offered as evidence (no outside verification needed, any type). Each comment is judged independently; list order is irrelevant. Purely abstract, logical, normative, or hypothetical/invented scenarios, and vague generic assertions without a specific example, don't qualify. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including an empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, or reports of whether the outcome occurred (even in argument or comments); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Use only current supplied text; don't infer initial snapshots or timing.
